- One-line purpose: Bilinear (2x2) image scaler IP.
- Version: 1.0.0

- Existing IP to reuse (do not duplicate):

| Module | From | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `axil_regbus` | `axil_regbus` | AXI4-Lite slave to register bus bridge. |

## 3. Parameters

| Name | Default | Meaning / legal range |
|---|---|---|
| `CHANNELS` | `3` | components per pixel |
| `COMP_W` | `8` | bits per component |
| `MAX_W` | `1920` | frame buffer width |
| `MAX_H` | `1080` | frame buffer height |
| `ADDR_W` | `14` | AXI-Lite address width |
| `PHASE_BITS` | `8` | sub-pixel phase resolution |
| `PINGPONG` | `0` | 1: double frame buffer (capture while generating) |
| `LINE_BUF` | `0` | 1: line-buffer mode (latency of a few lines; MAX_H is then not a limit, STEP_Y >= 0) |

Derived (localparam): `PIX_W = CHANNELS * COMP_W`.

Reject illegal values at elaboration with `$error` inside a generate block.

## 4. Clocks and resets

- Clocks: `clk`.
- Resets: `rst_n`.
- Clock and reset behaviour, and any clock-domain crossing, as described in section 6.

## 5. Interfaces

- **s_axil_*** - AXI4-Lite slave, address [ADDR_W-1:0], 32-bit data.
- **s_axis_t*** - AXI4-Stream slave (input), tdata [PIX_W-1:0], tuser, tlast. tdata = pixel, component 0 in LSBs; tready = low while generating; tuser = start of frame; tlast = end of line.
- **m_axis_t*** - AXI4-Stream master (output), tdata [PIX_W-1:0], tuser, tlast. tdata = scaled pixel; tready = back-pressure stalls all; tuser = start of frame; tlast = end of line.

| Port | Dir | Width | Group | Built when | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clk` | input | 1 | - | - | clock |
| `rst_n` | input | 1 | - | - | async reset, active low |

Back-pressure on every stream: honour tready, never drop data unless section 6 says so; valid must not depend combinationally on ready.

## 6. Function

Implement exactly this behaviour (from the reference design's specification):

```text
Bilinear (2x2) image scaler IP.
The 16.16 source coordinate s is rounded to PB = PHASE_BITS bits:
  s_r = s + 2^(15-PB); i = s_r >>> 16; f = s_r[15 -: PB]
With ONE = 2^PHASE_BITS and taps p00 p01 / p10 p11 at (i, i+1):
  top = p00*(ONE-fx) + p01*fx
  bot = p10*(ONE-fx) + p11*fx
  out = (top*(ONE-fy) + bot*fy + ONE^2/2) >> (2*PHASE_BITS)
Weights are computed in hardware; no coefficient tables.
Interfaces: AXI4-Lite control (common map in scaler_ctrl),
AXI4-Stream video in/out (tuser = SOF, tlast = EOL; pixel =
CHANNELS x COMP_W bits, component 0 in the LSBs).
Throughput: 1 output pixel/clock. Latency: one input frame (default
and PINGPONG = 1) or a few input lines (LINE_BUF = 1).
Uses: axil_regbus, scaler_ctrl, scaler_dda, banked_framebuf.
```

Describe and handle the edge cases, error recovery, latency and configuration-change rules stated above; where the text is silent, choose the safe option and document it in the file header.


## 7. Implementation constraints

- Synthesizable SystemVerilog-2012, technology independent (no vendor primitives; infer RAM and DSP).
- Must work in iverilog 12+ (`-g2012`), Verilator lint (`-Wall`, no UNOPTFLAT or latches) and Yosys.
- iverilog limits: declare before use; no enum ternaries without casts; no `break`; no arrays of queues; no `wait` on function calls; no declarations inside nested loop bodies of static initial blocks.
- No combinational path from a ready input back to a ready output; hoist scratch variables (no latches); split control and data `always_ff` blocks.
- Resources: report the Yosys utilisation; keep it in line with similar library blocks.

## 9. Verification requirements

The reference testbench checks the following; the new testbench must cover at least the same:

```text
Self-checking testbench for scaler_bilinear.
Runs the standard suite from scaler_tb_lib (identity, non-integer
up/down, mixed, 2x, 1x1 in/out, max size, junk before SOF, random
tvalid/tready stalls, full rate) and compares every output pixel
bit-exactly with an independent reference model (golden_pixel).
Plusargs: +IMG=<file.ppm> scale a PPM P6 image, +OUT_W/+OUT_H output
size, +OUTDIR=<dir>, +NO_PPM, +VCD=<file>, +NO_VCD, +TIMEOUT_MS=<n>.
Inputs/outputs are written as PPM P6 images. Compile with
-DTB_MAX_W/-DTB_MAX_H for images larger than 48x40.
```

Also: an independent reference model (not a copy of the RTL); random input gaps and output back-pressure on every stream; register readback; edge cases; a mutation check (break one rule, show the testbench fails).

Pass criteria: `make -C scalers/scaler_bilinear test` passes, Verilator lint clean, `make synth` passes.
